definition: Noxious means harmful or poisonous, especially to breathe or be exposed to.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word noxious. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know noxious should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Never mix bleach with ammonia: the pair releases noxious fumes that can sear your lungs in seconds.
An unpleasant smell merely offends the nose, while a noxious one can genuinely harm you.
A lethal gas is the extreme beyond noxious — deadly outright, not just harmful.

Toxic means poisonous to the body, and it is a property a substance carries wherever it sits — in a bottle, a bloodstream, or a landfill. Noxious adds the idea of exposure: fumes, gases, and vapors that harm people who breathe or contact them. Sealed mercury is toxic; the vapor escaping a broken seal is noxious.

Poisonous means capable of causing illness or death, and the harm usually travels by swallowing or touch — poisonous berries, a poisonous bite. Noxious harm arrives mostly on the air: fumes and gases that hurt you simply through exposure. A berry is poisonous on the tongue; a gas leak is noxious in the lungs.

When the city reopened the Fairmount subway station after a decade of closure, riders began reporting headaches on the lower platform.
An air-quality team traced the problem to idling work trains staged overnight in the dead-end tunnel, where exhaust pooled instead of venting to the street.
The readings settled the question.
Carbon monoxide and diesel particulates sat at levels the state classifies as noxious — air that injures the people who breathe it, not air that is merely stale.
The remedy was mechanical: two new fans now push fresh air down the shaft every four minutes.
